resolution.note: / 22.9% free (54.09 GiB) and /mnt/storage 27.7% free (129.79 GiB) on 2026-11-08 after the operator's cleanup and root-reclaim.sh; regrowth caps installed

title: Recover disk space on the system and storage disks
body:
Outcome: / and /mnt/storage each keep at least 20% free, per the operator ("dysk systemowy jest praktycznie full - musimy cos z tym zrobic", 2026-11-01).
Done 2026-11-01: deleted leaked review verdict trees in .krn/worktrees/context-budget/.krn/tmp (16.6 GB; /mnt/storage 100% -> 96%), go/uv caches (small). State then: / 94% (15 GB free), /mnt/storage 96% (18 GB free).
Remaining candidates (need operator decisions or sudo): btrfs snapshots and pacman cache 5.5 GB (sudo, paccache); ~/.local/share/containerd 7.4 GB + buildkit 5.5 GB (active user services); ~/.codex/thread_history_1.sqlite 12 GB and sessions 8.5 GB (operator: old used sessions must stay); /mnt/storage/coding: krn/lab 94 GB, Swieta-na-starowce 47 GB, seo-audit 34 GB, frontend-system 27 GB, ekologus-wp-local 24 GB, naster-hacked 22 GB, rekurencja.com 20 GB, plesk-cli 19 GB (other projects, ask before touching); /mnt/storage/backups 11 GB, krn-host-cache 8.1 GB. Survey: .krn/runs/delivery-loop/session-continuity/repo-hygiene/disk-survey.txt.
Related root-cause fix: t-7be2jjm.

2026-11-08 lead: / hit 100% (1.87 GiB free, btrfs data 220.6 GiB). Freed without sudo, regenerable caches only: buildkit build cache of the krn-ci runner builds (5.8 GB), uv cache (--force; the one lock holder, a wilq-seo uv run, runs from its project venv), mise prune --tools (10 unused versions) and mise cache clear, go build and module caches, yay build dirs, pip, debuginfod, opencode, composer, staticcheck and pnpm metadata caches, ~/.nuget/packages. Result: / 11.8 GiB free (5%, btrfs data 210.6 GiB); /mnt/storage 113 GiB free (24%, meets the floor). zstd:3 compression makes du overstate: the 5.0 GB uv cache freed 1.3 GiB. Kept: Codex sessions and thread_history (operator), Claude transcripts, Steam and Games, other projects' data (s2d-trials 2.5 GB, mise-en-plesk 2.7 GB, voxtype 3.2 GB), krn-ci runner images (they serve other repositories). Left for root, about 36 GiB short of the floor: an estimated 40 GiB of btrfs data outside every readable tree (snapper root snapshots), /var/cache/pacman/pkg 6.2 GB with no paccache timer, /var/lib/systemd/coredump 2.2 GB (923 dumps: 448 agent-browser Chrome, 156 mise), journal 2.7 GB; the 30.7 GiB hibernation swapfile is the operator's call. Operator step: sudo bash .krn/runs/delivery-loop/session-continuity/disk-recovery/root-reclaim.sh (reclaims the above, keeps the newest snapshot pair, caps dumps at 1 GB and the journal at 500 MB, enables paccache.timer). Recurrence: the SessionStart hook prints a Disk line while the home or project disk is under 20% free.

2026-11-08 10:38 lead: after the operator's own cleanup and a root run of root-reclaim.sh (paccache found nothing to prune, journal 232.8 MB, core dumps 0, snapper kept its 2 snapshots), df shows / 54.09 GiB free of 236.5 GiB (22.9%) and /mnt/storage 129.79 GiB free of 468.4 GiB (27.7%). Regrowth caps are live: coredump MaxUse=1G, journald SystemMaxUse=500M, paccache.timer enabled. Record: .krn/runs/delivery-loop/session-continuity/disk-recovery/df-final.txt.
